introduction.title: Hi, I'm Ayoub
introduction.subtitle: Full Stack Developer
introduction.description: I'm a passionate Full Stack Developer with expertise in building modern web applications. I love creating efficient, scalable, and user-friendly solutions.
introduction.hobbies: When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or enjoying outdoor activities.

tomtomAmigo.title: TomTom AmiGO
tomtomAmigo.description: TomTom AmiGO is a free and adless GPS navigation mobile app available on Android and iOS also supporting Android Auto and Carplay, it offers a lot of features such as trusted maps, real-time traffic updates, speed camera alerts, etc…
tomtomAmigo.techStack: Used: React Native, Redux Saga, Jest, Java, Kotlin, Swift

escooterFinder.title: E-Scooter Finder
escooterFinder.description: Android application, which finds you nearby e-scooters from various electric scooter sharing companies.
escooterFinder.frontend: Frontend: Kotlin, Google Maps SDK, Retrofit, Android Studio
escooterFinder.backend: Backend: Kotlin Spring, RestTemplate, Spring Data JPA, PostGIS, AWS
escooterFinder.patterns: Patterns: MVVM, Observer, Repository, Singleton, REST

curriculumSimulator.title: Curriculum Simulator
curriculumSimulator.description: Java Spring web application for students of my school to see which subjects are accessible to them according to the subjects they have passed.
curriculumSimulator.techStack: Used: Java, Spring Boot, Bootstrap, Thymeleaf, Lombok, H2

stibRide.title: Stib Ride
stibRide.description: JavaFX application that allows users to get the shortest path between two metro station in the public transport network of Brussels.
stibRide.techStack: Used: Java, JavaFx, Scene Builder, SQLite
stibRide.patterns: Patterns: MVP, Observer, Repository, Dao, Dto

rainbowAttack.title: Rainbow Attack
rainbowAttack.description: Developed in the context of my cyber security course. This TUI C++ application allows you to generate a rainbow table and crack sha256 hashed passwords using the previously generated rainbow table.

readingEsi.title: Reading Esi
readingEsi.description: Reading Esi is an odoo module helping bookstore organizations to store, rent, buy and sell books

abalone.title: Abalone
abalone.description: Developed the Abalone game using C++ and QT Designer while following the OOP principles.

game2048.description: My JavaFX implementation of the 2048 game following the OOP principles

about.title: About Me
about.description:
Hello, I'm Ayoub Lahyaoui a {{age}}-year-old Belgian software developer.
I enjoy socializing, meeting new people, and learning about different cultures, which leads me to enjoy traveling.
I have been fortunate to visit a few countries and hope to visit more in the future.
As a computer and technology enthusiast, I've developed a wide range of skills in a variety of computer-related fields, making me a highly adaptable individual.
I strive to make use of all of my abilities but also to acquire new ones in order to help me complete my work as efficiently as possible.
